chemistry.stereo_source: original explicit chemistry spec; SDF geometry retained

geometry.torsion_scope: Heavy-atom amide planarity; ETKDG matched torsion angles are diagnostic. General rotor preference violations are not assigned a universal cutoff.

protein.altloc_policy: First model; highest occupancy per residue/atom name, ties blank then A
protein.preparation_scope: Original pocket PDB. No new protonation or missing-sidechain repair.
protein.receptor_type_policy: Protein clash rate uses protein atoms only. Organic cofactors use vdW and inorganic cofactors covalent radii, with identical 0.75 ratio. Raw inorganic vdW overlaps retained for audit; metal coordination is not automatically a protein collision. Full cofactor tests remain in standard PoseBusters gate.
protein.interaction_limitations: Heavy-atom distance contacts only. Donor direction, hydrogen placement/protonation and solvent exposure are not validated; buried unsatisfied polarity and directional hydrogen bonds are unavailable.

forcefield.interpretation: Original heavy atoms fixed during added-H relaxation. Full local minimization is diagnostic only, with unchanged graph, no receptor and no replacement of model output. Absolute energies are not comparable across molecules.

posebusters.energy_note: Standard package thresholds and 50-conformer UFF reference ensemble, ETKDG randomSeed=42. Only num_threads is fixed to 1; no fast mode or energy skipping.
